svg.aria-label: Crop margins: a page at Fit width before cropping, its printed area framed, and the same page after — the camera moved in, the text larger, the running head and page number kept; a right-hand and a left-hand page with their own frames for alternating margins; and an iPad in portrait with the cropped page at reading size and the Crop margins switch on in the Type panel
svg.text: a third of the width is margin
framed on what is printed: nothing is cut
The first time, the paper is measured: the switch says
so and the page waits; then one move, your line kept.
Kept with the paper, in plugin data. The PDF is never written. A scan says cropping needs its text.
A printed book's margins alternate; each side gets
its own frame, the same size, so the text never
changes size as you turn. A title page or a short
last page uses its side's frame — never blown up.
